_INSTRUCTIONS: Copy this file to config.json (in the same folder) and fill in your values.
Do NOT rename this file — the tool reads config.json, not config.example.json.

notes.aoi: The area of interest. Accepts a shapefile, a GeoJSON file, a feature class in a geodatabase, or a plain bounding box string like '44.0,22.0,48.0,26.0' (minx,miny,maxx,maxy in WGS84). Points and lines are accepted and are buffered into search areas automatically. Use forward slashes (C:/...). Each feature produces its own mosaic.
notes.output_folder: Folder where results (GDB files) will be saved. Created automatically if it does not exist. Use a local drive with enough free space.
notes.start_date: Start of the date range to search for scenes. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
notes.end_date: End of the date range. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
notes.cloud_cover: Maximum scene cloud cover percentage to accept (0 = clear sky only, 100 = any). Recommended: 5-15. Note this is measured over the whole satellite tile, not just your AOI.
notes.area_name: Optional prefix added to all output mosaic names. E.g. 'KSA' produces KSA_Feature_1, KSA_Basin_A. Leave empty for no prefix.
notes.mrf_cache_folder: Local folder used as a tile cache. Leave as default unless you need a different drive. Must have several GB of free space.
notes.name_field: Optional: a field in your AOI whose value names each mosaic (e.g. 'name'). Leave empty to auto-name as Feature_1, Feature_2, ...
notes.aoi_buffer_meters: Optional: expand every AOI by this many metres before searching. Points and lines always get at least a 100 m buffer since they have no area of their own.
notes.scene_selection: How scenes are chosen. 'all' keeps every scene in range. 'best_scene_only' keeps the best scene for each tile ranked purely on cloud cover, whatever its date, so the mosaic is built from the clearest imagery found anywhere in the date range; date only breaks ties between equally clear scenes. 'date_coherent' instead keeps a single acquisition day (the one covering the most tiles), for change detection or any question where one mosaic must represent one moment.
notes.template_packs: Which raster function templates to attach to the mosaic. Use ['all'] for everything, or pick from: imagery, vegetation, water, fire, urban, geology, snow. E.g. ['imagery','water'] for a flood-mapping job.
notes.months: Optional: restrict scenes to specific months. E.g. [6,7,8] for June, July, August only. Leave as [] to include all months in the date range.
